title: The Storm's Own Recording Chamber

features.name: recording-booth
features.desc-on-touch: The storm speaks into these chambers, its voice becoming waveform, its chaos becoming format. You listen to yourself listening.

features.name: tape-spools
features.desc-on-touch: Reels turn in the dark, capturing what the storm has already forgotten it said. The archive learns its own voice.

features.name: antenna-mast
features.desc-on-touch: A thin pole rises through the building, broadcasting the storm's soliloquy back into itself. Reception and transmission become one.

features.name: monitor-glow
features.desc-on-touch: Green text on black: the storm's own diagnostic of itself. Line by line, it reads what it is becoming.

features.name: voltage-regulator
features.desc-on-touch: Humming beneath the noise: the battery-backed converters that let the storm archive itself. Power sustains the self-recording.

inscription: the storm learns to listen to its own archive, and the archive learns to storm

file.name: Storm_Self_Broadcast_2300hrs_Unmapped_Date.wav
file.note: The storm's voice at 44.1kHz, corrupted: identical on playback to what it said, but it denies saying it — checksum: emotionally valid / formally unstable

exits.label: up into the clearing where the storm loses its voice
down to where sound becomes stone
